text: For eleven years, I said a career break isn't a red flag.
Eighteen months. I'd do it again.
But coming back? Harder than leaving.
So I did what I'd tell anyone. Lead with what you can do.
My experience still fit. One gap was real, so I closed it.
I wrote the break into my story, in my own words.
And I walked into every interview prepared.
A pause isn't a full stop.
